decisions.reason: The source decision applies to the later single integrated board; it does not alter the separate main board's existing mechanical layout.
The source decision concerns orientation of the single integrated board, not the separate sensor board mounted in the earlier multiboard enclosure.
The integrated-board orientation choice does not revise the separate power board's mechanical layout or enclosure position.
Allowing the designer to select mounting orientation does not change the integrated board's cost, sourcing, connector-reduction, or functionality-preservation requirements.
The mechanical orientation decision does not alter the backlight circuit topology, connector, supply options, control, or load requirements.
The board remains a single integrated board preserving all functions regardless of the designer-selected mounting orientation.
Selecting orientation for the cleanest connector layout does not change the requirement that all connectors use through-hole assembly.
The integrated board's orientation does not change the required I2C JST connector for the ambient light sensor.
The mechanical orientation choice does not alter the ESP32 breakout pin-header pitch.
The mounting-orientation decision does not modify charging behavior, required rails, battery-efficiency goals, or the selected AXP2101 component.
The integrated board's orientation has no necessary effect on current-measurement capability or whether a separate INA device is required.
The source concerns the single integrated board and does not revise the separate power board's battery connector, pinout, placement, or electrical interface.
